clues.text: God told Moses that Israel's day of rest in the seventh month would be announced by its blasts.
Jesus taught that when you give to the needy, do not sound this before you like the hypocrites.
Jesus said the Son of Man will send His angels with its loud call to gather His elect.
Paul told the Corinthians that at the last one, the dead will be raised imperishable in an instant.
At Jericho, when the people heard its blast, they gave a great shout and the wall collapsed.
John saw seven angels holding these; when the first sounded, hail and fire mixed with blood fell.
Gideon's three hundred men blew these and smashed their jars, crying out for the LORD and for Gideon.
